raw_response: {"cause":"Overconcurrency (queue started with max 4 concurrent films on a 16 GB RAM / 4 GB GPU host) caused the local animation service on port 8765 to crash/refuse connections, leaving EP05 unable to generate required ANIM cuts, repeatedly failing stage 3 MILP mix replanning, and hanging or dying without progress.","fix_now":"Restart the local animation service (127.0.0.1:8765), lower the queue concurrency to 2, and restart EP05 from stage 3.","prevent":"Enforce a hard max concurrency limit of 2 concurrent runs in the batch queue configuration on 16 GB machines, and add health checks with automatic process restarts and backoff timeouts for the port 8765 service."}

data.cause: Overconcurrency (queue started with max 4 concurrent films on a 16 GB RAM / 4 GB GPU host) caused the local animation service on port 8765 to crash/refuse connections, leaving EP05 unable to generate required ANIM cuts, repeatedly failing stage 3 MILP mix replanning, and hanging or dying without progress.
data.fix_now: Restart the local animation service (127.0.0.1:8765), lower the queue concurrency to 2, and restart EP05 from stage 3.
data.prevent: Enforce a hard max concurrency limit of 2 concurrent runs in the batch queue configuration on 16 GB machines, and add health checks with automatic process restarts and backoff timeouts for the port 8765 service.
